violations.text: The cold-hold unit at the grill (for eggs, burgers) was observed in poor repair, with an ambient temperature of 49 degrees and water accumulation at the bottom of unit. PIC placed work order during inspection. Recently placed eggs were moved to the walk-in. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026
A leak was observed at the faucet of the 3-bay sink. Workorder was placed during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 04/10/2025

Chili which was previously cooked and cooled, was only reheated to 107 degrees Fahrenheit for hot holding. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding must be reheated to 165 degrees Fahrenheit or above for 15 seconds. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/24/2025
The dumpster enclosure has an accumulation of leaf litter and debris. New Violation. Correct By: 03/24/2025
